audit.why: 48.11% over 1139 games. Jayce out-ranges a 550-range Vayne with no items for five levels; from her first item Silver Bolts stat-checks a zero-defence caster and it never comes back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is sided Jayce while whys[0] calls it 'an even last-hit standoff'. First item is sided Skill and 2+ items sided Jayce, while spikes[2] says the poke war 'flips into a stat-check your squishy Jayce frame loses' and late says 'past that point you simply lose the 1v1'.
audit.why: Both item stages are handed to Jayce or called even by the chart while every caption under them describes Vayne taking the lane outright.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0] set to Skill; win[5], win[6] and their phases set to Vayne. I deliberately did NOT apply the packet reference chart's Vayne at levels 3 and 6 — the page's own text says you out-poke her through that whole stretch and I will not invent a power shift the prose contradicts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) The page says a two-item Vayne 'tumbles invisible' as if it were a standing property of Tumble. Riot: the Invisibility during Tumble comes from Final Hour (R), a 100/85/70s ultimate — outside it she is fully visible. (b) Silver Bolts is described as 'every 3rd auto'. Riot: 'the third CONSECUTIVE attack or ability against the SAME target'. Switching targets, or you breaking off, resets the count.
audit.why: (a) changes when you are allowed to fight her at all: if Final Hour is down she is a visible 550-range marksman, not a ghost. (b) is the counterplay — disengaging at two stacks costs her the whole payload, and the count includes abilities, so Condemn can carry a stack too.
audit.corrected: Final Hour named as the source of the invisibility and Silver Bolts' same-target consecutive rule stated, in late, whys[5], spikes[3] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never gives Condemn's cooldown or says when the stun does and does not happen.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s and only stuns if the knockback collides with terrain — in open ground it is a displacement and nothing else. Tumble falls to a 2s cooldown by rank 5 and is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell. Final Hour is 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: 20s Condemn and the terrain condition stated in mid.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your window to bank a real health lead and take plates — she still has no items, so the poke war keeps tilting your way and she can only kite, not fight. Remember your R is just the stance-swap, not a fresh power spike, but Vayne's level 6 gives her nothing that beats the poke either, so keep forcing the trade: gate-Q to soften, then Hammer Q-E-W when she walks up. Save Thundering Blow to knock her out of her tumble-kite when she over-extends for a cannon, and convert every advantage into objectives before her items arrive.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your window to bank a real health lead and take plates — she still has no items, so the poke war keeps tilting your way and she can only kite, not fight. Her Condemn is 20s at rank 1 and it only stuns if it slams you into terrain; fought in open ground it is a knockback and nothing more. Your R is just the stance-swap, and Vayne's level 6 gives her nothing that beats the poke, so keep forcing the trade: gate-Q to soften, then Hammer Q-E-W when she walks up. Save Thundering Blow for her tumble-kite and convert every advantage into objectives.

edits.before: Once she finishes a first item the lane inverts — Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage ignores your defenses and stat-checks your squishy frame, and the cannon-swap MR/Armor shred that carried your early poke stops mattering. Your stance-swap burst can't kill a Vayne who tumbles invisible mid-rotation and condemns you into a wall. This is a race: every plate and kill you banked in the first five levels has to be spent on objectives and a closed map before two items, because past that point you simply lose the 1v1.
edits.after: Once she finishes a first item the lane inverts — Silver Bolts fires on the third CONSECUTIVE hit against the same target for percent-max-HP true damage, so breaking off resets the count, and the cannon-swap shred that carried your early poke stops mattering. Her invisible tumbles exist only while Final Hour is up, a 100s ult; outside it she is a visible 550-range marksman. This is a race: every plate and kill you banked in the first five levels has to be spent on objectives and a closed map before two items, because past that you lose the 1v1.

edits.before: Two-item Vayne tumbles invisible through your combo and condemns you into a wall — she out-trades your burst even when you land it.
edits.after: Two-item Vayne condemns you into terrain and, while Final Hour is up, tumbles invisible through your combo — she out-trades your burst.

edits.before: Two-item Vayne tumbles invisible (Q) mid-combo and condemns (E) you into a wall — your stance-swap burst can't catch her and her true damage shreds you regardless of armor.
edits.after: Two-item Vayne condemns (E) you into terrain and, with Final Hour up, tumbles invisible mid-combo — your stance-swap burst can't catch her and her true damage ignores armor.

edits.before: Stack Silver Bolts (every 3rd hit = percent-max-HP true damage) to stat-check your squishy frame once she has a first item
edits.after: Stack Silver Bolts without switching targets — the third consecutive hit is percent-max-HP true damage — once her first item lands

notes: Tumble's invisibility comes from Final Hour, not from Tumble — the page read as though a two-item Vayne is permanently invisible when she dashes. Silver Bolts counts CONSECUTIVE hits on the SAME target and includes abilities, so disengaging at two stacks is real counterplay the page never offered. Condemn only stuns into terrain. I did not adopt the packet reference chart wholesale here: it sides Vayne at levels 3 and 6, and this page's own text says you out-poke her through both, so I changed only the stages where chart and prose actually contradict.
